events.name: High-Altitude Radar Track Lock
events.description: The perimeter radar locks onto something falling — a tungsten rod, left over from a war fought by people who never intended to survive it. It tumbles through decaying orbit with the lazy patience of a thing that has all the time in the world.

events.name: Thermal Descent Plasma Signature
events.description: A white-hot streak tears across the sky like a crack in the firmament, visible even through the ash haze. The thermal imagers scream as something plunges through the mesosphere, aimed directly at Sector 4 — and there is absolutely nothing anyone can do but watch it fall.
events.radio_hook_text: THERMAL ALERT: Ionization track confirmed at 80 km... descent vector locked.

events.name: Deep Infrasound Shock Precursor
events.description: The walls hum. A deep, bass vibration that rattles teeth and loosens bolts — the bedrock itself flinching as a military penetrator screams through the upper atmosphere, punching a shockwave ahead of it into the earth.

events.name: Fragmented Ballast Rod Scatter
events.description: The radar track splits into two. A tungsten rod has fractured during reentry, its halves tumbling apart on diverging trajectories — each one still carrying enough kinetic energy to punch through four metres of reinforced concrete.

events.name: Telemetry Station Cluster Shower
events.description: A dead satellite breaks apart in the upper atmosphere, scattering a constellation of burning fragments across the shelter's roof quadrants. It looks like fireworks — the last fireworks anyone will ever see — and each one hits like a mortar round.

events.name: Defense Submunition Cluster Strike
events.description: Infrared tracking captures a single incoming signature deploying three distinct submunition reentry vehicles across shelter perimeter coordinates.

events.name: High-Altitude EMP Airburst Precursor
events.description: Static cascades across all shortwave frequencies as a degrading high-altitude nuclear battery discharges ionized burst energy above the troposphere.
events.radio_hook_text: COMM STATIC: Automated orbital battery discharge sequence active... EMP burst warning...

events.name: Ionized Plasma Arc Shockwave
events.description: Sensors report high electromagnetic flux paired with a weak kinetic profile, indicating an airburst plasma shockwave that threatens unshielded busbars.

events.name: Automated Dead-Hand Command Relay
events.description: An automated pre-war dead-hand satellite pings continuous binary activation sequences, initiating an emergency orbital repositioning maneuver.
events.radio_hook_text: CARRIER DETECT: 4.882 MHz repeating digital chirp — PROTOCOL CRIMSON-SEVEN CONFIRMED.

events.name: Corrupted Defense Grid Ping
events.description: A decaying military command platform transmits corrupt telemetry packets while autonomously releasing ballast penetrators on an unguided descent trajectory.
events.radio_hook_text: INTERCEPT: Garbled framing packet... CHECKSUM INVALID... autonomous descent vector engaged.

events.name: Tropospheric Radar Ducting Echo
events.description: Atmospheric inversion creates a false radar phantom mimicking a descending ballast rod. Tracking disappears harmlessly upon sensor recalibration.

events.name: Decaying Weather Balloon Misclassification
events.description: A shredded high-altitude foil meteorological balloon enters radar coverage, triggering an anomalous threat warning that dissolves harmlessly in upper winds.
